_comment: AGENTS.md rule 43: one operation, one implementation. Each entry names the one owner of an operation
and the AST signatures that implement it. tests/test_one_implementation_per_operation.py counts every
signature outside the owners, per file, and compares with one_implementation_baseline.json.
A count above baseline, or a file missing from the baseline, fails. A count below baseline also fails
until the baseline is lowered in the same commit, so the ceiling only goes down.
Signature kinds: calls (fully-qualified, import aliases resolved), method (attribute name on any object),
name_calls (a bare or attribute call of this function name), numbers (float literals), strings (exact
string literals), detector (named custom AST rule in the test).
Owners are repo-relative paths; a trailing '/' owns a folder. owner_function documents the entry point
callers must use; enforcement is per owner module.

object_regionprops_table.description: Per-object morphology/intensity tables from label images (regionprops).

cytoplasm_derivation.description: Cytoplasm = cell labels with nucleus (and other) pixels zeroed.
cytoplasm_derivation.covered_by: ops_sample site: ws-offload-ws-ops-measure-shared; OPS engine, flat-field, host-pathogen and utils: ws-offload-ws-merge23 (one cytoplasm); qt/mask_engine keeps 1 (the Make Masks preview, a different operation)

nucleus_cell_ownership.description: Which cell owns each nucleus or child object: label overlaps, the best parent per child, cells merged when one child spans them, and the nucleus-to-cell assignment.
nucleus_cell_ownership.owner_function: spacr.measure._label_overlaps / _best_parent / _merge_spanning_children / _assign_nuclei_to_cells (with the nucleus fragment merge, the small-piece merge and the cell-less handling of item 1024)
nucleus_cell_ownership.covered_by: Measure, External Masks, OPS (ops_sample.pair_nuclei_with_cells), time-lapse and utils._merge_overlapping_objects: ws-offload-ws-merge23 (one ownership); ops_large_sites.merge_small_nuclei (921/965) through the shared pairing: item 1024
nucleus_cell_ownership.no_signature: the overlap count is generic numpy, so no AST signature; callers call the owner functions

cellpose_model_construction.description: Constructing a Cellpose model from a resolved checkpoint.

cellpose_governed_eval.description: Running a segmentation model under the GPU governor.

border_clearing.description: Removing labels that touch the field border.

classical_threshold.description: Global/local intensity thresholds for classical segmentation.

raster_decode.description: Decoding raw rasters (TIFF and friends) from disk.
raster_decode.covered_by: stored-array/mask format: WS 0aj; OPS plane policy: 1010b section 1

measurements_db_path.description: Building the project's measurements.db path by hand (one file structure).
measurements_db_path.covered_by: contents of measurements/: unified store section 2.1; path helper: audit E6

translation_registration.description: Estimating translation between images (phase correlation / ECC).

phate_leiden.owner_function: spacr.ops_clusters._phate_graph (the PHATE graph) / leiden_partitions (every Leiden call)
phate_leiden.covered_by: phate_leiden, gene_graph, fused_phate_graph and leiden_short: audit D10

label_pair_contingency.description: Pixel overlap counts of every object pair of two label images (agreement, IoU, pairing).
label_pair_contingency.covered_by: ops_large_sites agreement (mask_agreement, _split_merge, tiling_control) and model_compare.object_overlap: audit B19

column_standardise.description: Column mean and SD for centring and scaling profiles (x.std(0) written in place).
column_standardise.covered_by: the profile embedders, TVNModel.standardise and the c0 recipe: audit D6 and D8

robust_scale_constant.description: MAD-to-SD constant written inline (robust z / MAD fences).

thread_caps.owner_function: one thread-cap owner beside resource_log (audit E5b)

figure_save.description: Saving figures. Enforced by tests/test_every_kept_figure_goes_through_one_writer.py; listed for completeness.

flat_field.description: Flat-field fit, normalisation convention and application. One numerical owner, one map convention recorded in metadata.
flat_field.delegated_to: item 1009 (no AST signature: the estimators use generic numpy)

field_seam_ownership.description: Which overlapping field owns a cell imaged in two or more fields (seam ownership): the copies matched across fields and one owner per physical cell, the field whose centre is nearest the cell centroid among the fields that hold it whole.
field_seam_ownership.covered_by: OPS ph_ownership (ops_cross_field_ownership, the item 874 rule corrected), the merge pairing (owner copy first), aggregate, ph_tables and the crops: ws-offload-ws-ops-seam-ownership
field_seam_ownership.no_signature: nearest-centre and edge tests are generic numpy, so no AST signature; callers call the owner functions
field_seam_ownership.remaining: ops_ownership 'a1'/'a1b' in ops_engine._ph_merge (deprecated, deepest in the footprint) and the large-site tile stitch in ops_large_sites (deepest from an inner tile edge, painted into one label image)
